title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs site quickstarts
author: Jordan Reeves
description: Motivation: provide first-class RAG/agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples to help developers onboard faster and to reduce repeated support questions. This PR adds opinionated RAG agent templates, a small set of tool-calling example agents, corresponding example notebooks, and docs site quickstarts with copyable snippets and troubleshooting notes. What changed (high level): added a new docs quickstart page, three agent templates (faq-rag, search-assistant, ticket-triage), tool integrations for a mock HTTP tool and a simple DB lookup tool used by examples, and updated the examples repo and docs sidebar. Also added unit tests for the example agents and a docs smoke test. Checklist: [x] Quickstarts written and staged under docs/quickstarts/rag-agent.md; [x] Example agents added under redwood-examples/agents/; [x] Tool stubs and interface docs added under redwood-examples/tools/; [x] Tests added and CI green after fix; [x] Docs site navigation and sidebar updated. Testing notes: initial CI run reported a flaky docs-smoke test (timeout on local snippet execution). I increased the timeout for the smoke runner and added deterministic seeds for the example notebooks. After that CI passed (see CI checks). Related: ENG-4821 (RAG onboarding), DOCS-98 (quickstart rewrites), references to earlier RAG quickstart PRs for format/examples. Usage: the quickstart includes full copy-paste examples for the JavaScript and Python SDKs, a minimal production config for Dedicated, and a short troubleshooting section covering tokenization/sequence length and caching considerations. Notes for reviewers: pay attention to the suggested defaults in the templates (context window, chunk size, embeddings model) - these are intentionally conservative to prioritize correctness for new users. If we want more aggressive defaults we should follow up with a metrics-backed rollout.
